required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard federal application form with authorized organizational representative endorsement.

required_documents.name: Project Abstract Summary
required_documents.details: Single-spaced concise summary of program purpose, population served, and core healthcare services.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Comprehensive narrative addressing Needs Assessment, Methodology, Work Plan, and Evaluation Plan.

required_documents.name: SF-424A and Budget Justification Narrative
required_documents.details: Federal line-item budget form and narrative justifying personnel, equipment, travel, and healthcare contracts.

required_documents.name: Rural Partner Letters of Agreement / MOUs
required_documents.details: Signed partnership agreements with rural health providers, clinics, or community organizations.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov and Grants.gov Workspace Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with valid UEI and Grants.gov AOR credentials.

eligibility.summary: Any domestic public or private entity, including an Indian tribe or tribal organization (as those terms are defined at 25 U.S.C. § 450b) is eligible to apply. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity HRSA-27-038.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
